description.p: LumenPass is a modern password manager that natively reads and writes the KeePass KDBX 3 and KDBX 4 vault formats. It provides a 1Password-style interface for managing logins, passkeys, TOTP codes, SSH keys, identities, secure notes and bank/payment cards.

ul.li: Full KDBX 3 and KDBX 4 read/write support.
System tray integration, biometric unlock and OS keyring backing.
Built-in TOTP generator, password generator and audit reports.
Optional cloud sync with Google Drive and Dropbox.
Cross-platform with macOS and Windows desktop releases.

description.p: Add release-deb.sh one-shot orchestrator and refreshed release docs.
Initial Debian release of LumenPass for Linux.
